prerequisites: Current diversity policy and prior initiative records received
activities.procedure_required: Read the current diversity policy and prior initiative records end-to-end; document strengths, gaps, target history, and outcomes against the applicable code and review frameworks.
activities.safety_hold_point: Policy is missing, unsigned, or more than 24 months out of date with no review record - flag as a compliance and credibility risk before proceeding.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Review note signed off by the DEI Policy Lead covering policy content, targets, and prior outcomes.

prerequisites: Access to chair, nomination chair, and CEO confirmed
activities.procedure_required: Finalise the semi-structured elite interview protocol, consent form, and confidentiality provisions; obtain ethics and GC approval before any interview is conducted.
activities.safety_hold_point: Protocol or consent form not approved, or confidentiality provisions inadequate for board-level informants - hold interviews until approved.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Protocol, consent form, and confidentiality approach approved by GC and engagement lead; informants briefed.

activities.procedure_required: Cross-reference the board register with the annual report, Companies House, and the company website. Flag discrepancies older than 24 hours for resolution.
activities.safety_hold_point: Discrepancy rate greater than 5% between sources - hold for clarification before proceeding to benchmark.
activities.acceptance_criteria: All board member data (name, gender, ethnicity, age, tenure, independence, committee membership) confirmed against a minimum of two sources.

prerequisites: Comparator universe and data source agreed
activities.procedure_required: Document the benchmarking methodology: comparator set (FTSE 350/250 and sector peers), metrics, weighting, and treatment of small-N boards; obtain sponsor and analytics sign-off.
activities.safety_hold_point: Comparator universe not defensible or metrics inconsistent with regulatory definitions - hold before producing the benchmark report.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Methodology note signed off by sponsor and Data Analytics Lead; comparator set documented.

activities.procedure_required: Submit draft policy, appointment process, and target methodology to GC for review of legality (avoiding unlawful quotas), data protection, and disclosure alignment.
activities.safety_hold_point: Legal flags risk of unlawful quota, discrimination exposure, or disclosure non-compliance - hold adoption until remediated.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Written legal sign-off with any conditions resolved and documented.

activities.procedure_required: Prepare and review board presentation materials for accuracy, tone, and confidentiality; confirm no data is presented outside the agreed access ring-fence; obtain sponsor approval.
activities.safety_hold_point: Materials contain non-ring-fenced sensitive data or unverified claims - hold presentation until corrected.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Materials approved by sponsor and Governance Advisory Lead; data handling confirmed compliant.

activities.procedure_required: Place the diversity policy adoption on the board agenda; secure a formal resolution; minute the decision and prepare any AGM resolution materials.
activities.safety_hold_point: Resolution deferred without a revised date within the AGM cycle - escalate as a disclosure-slip risk.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Board resolution adopted and minuted; AGM materials lodged where required.

activities.procedure_required: Deploy the dashboard against the kpi_definitions.json set; verify each KPI renders from validated data with correct access roles; confirm variance triggers are active.
activities.safety_hold_point: KPIs render from unvalidated data or access controls inadequate for sensitive metrics - hold go-live until resolved.
activities.acceptance_criteria: All KPIs verified live against validated data; access roles and variance triggers confirmed.

prerequisites: Annual effectiveness review completed under new framework
activities.procedure_required: Complete the annual effectiveness review; share findings with the board; obtain acceptance that findings and recommended actions are agreed and owned.
activities.safety_hold_point: Effectiveness score has declined materially and findings are unaddressed - hold acceptance until remediation owners are assigned.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Review report accepted by the board with actions assigned to owners and dates.

activities.procedure_required: Compile the engagement close-out report (scope, outcomes, residual risks, handover); confirm knowledge transfer to the client governance team; obtain sponsor acceptance.
activities.safety_hold_point: Residual risks unowned or knowledge transfer incomplete - hold close-out until owners and handover are confirmed.
activities.acceptance_criteria: Close-out report accepted by sponsor; capability handover confirmed; residual risks owned.
